name: Land, lakes & rivers
caption: Lakes and branching rivers break up the land. Follow the banks to find your next crossing.

name: Large islands
caption: Long coastlines surround substantial islands. Ports connect your foothold to the next landmass.

name: Medium islands
caption: Separate islands create a chain of coastal fronts. Watch the water between them as closely as the land.

name: Small islands
caption: Small footholds, short sea crossings, and ships on the move. Every landing opens another front.

name: Atoll
caption: A narrow ring of land surrounds open water. River cuts and coastal approaches shape the fight.

name: World
caption: Recognizable continents meet the new terrain detail. This view follows the coasts and waterways between Europe, Africa, and Asia.

name: Europe
caption: A close view of central Europe, with textured ground, river crossings, coastal routes, and developing nations.

name: Americas
caption: Central America links the land fronts while the Caribbean opens routes by sea. The coast is part of the battlefield.

name: Africa
caption: Follow the waterways toward the Horn of Africa and the Red Sea, where land fronts meet coastal shipping routes.

name: Asia
caption: Long inland fronts lead to the coasts and islands of East and Southeast Asia. Zoom in to read the shoreline and river channels.

name: Middle East
caption: The Gulf and its surrounding coasts bring land borders, narrow waterways, and naval approaches into one view.
